[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Vantage Data Centers facility, VA15, is part of Vantages Ashburn I campus in Sterling, Virginia. Per Vantages own official page for Ashburn I (tier-1 operator source, https://vantage-dc.com/data-center-locations/north-america/ashburn-i-virginia/), this 52 acre campus at 45200 Vantage Data Plaza, Sterling, VA 20166, totals 1.7 million square feet at full buildout, over 1 million already operational, and 206 MW of critical IT load, at densities up to 300 W per square foot. The operator describes the campus as eventually housing six multi-story facilities, matching the six VA1-numbered rows (VA11 through VA16) this registry tracks at this campus. Because the 206 MW and 1.7 million sq ft figures are campus-wide totals across all six buildings, not confirmed as this specific buildings own figure, they are not applied to critical_it_mw. No individual building specific MW or square footage figure distinct from the six-building campus total was found published for this specific row this session.
